text:
Eli M: Quick flag - product noted console shows RED for some fallbacks while API returns 200. Support is getting tickets.
Priya S: This is the graceful fallback to cheaper model case. We return 200 with a note but console treated it as a failure.
Ravi K: We should standardize: server_tag enum + client_code string + http mapping + console badge + telemetry keys. Minimal set.
Maya Chen: Proposal: server_tag in [ok,degraded,throttled,quota_block,error]; client_code like ROUTE_DEGRADED / QUOTA_EXCEEDED / QUEUE_THROTTLED. Map DEGRADED->200, THROTTLED/QUOTA->429, ERROR->503.
Eli M: Implementation: add headers X-Redwood-Server-Tag and X-Redwood-Client-Code. SDKs must surface ROUTE_DEGRADED as a warning even when 200.
Priya S: Telemetry: emit fallback_model, route_reason, quota_bucket, retry_after_secs, and metric success_but_degraded. Alert if fallback_rate > 3% (1m).
Ravi K: Console: ok->green, degraded->amber (tooltip: "Routed to lower-cost model. Results may vary."), throttled/quota->red with upgrade CTA.
ci-bot: build-check: no conflicts detected.
Maya Chen: Action items: Ravi - add headers & metrics; Priya - draft enum table + curl examples; Eli - SDK warning pattern. Flip feature flag next Tuesday after smoke tests.
